svg.title: Tiny Robot Lab — Infrastructure and Delivery Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram illustrating the public request path via Cloudflare Tunnel to home-core, separately hosted website, GitHub development and delivery workflow, and layered monitoring.

g.text: Tiny Robot Lab — Infrastructure & Delivery Architecture
Public Ingress • Cloudflare Tunnel • home-core Hosting • GitHub Delivery • Layered Observability
Public request ingress and separately hosted project surfaces
• Routes agent traffic privately to Cloudflare Tunnel
• Publishes project context, notes, and lab index
• Task state storage and event logging
Agents pull tasks via bounded claims;
no public ingress touches agent services.
Response returns through the same protected path.
Independent engineering lifecycle, quality gates, and human acceptance authority
CI gates must pass before review
“The pipeline does not end at a green check. Every issue should leave the development system slightly better at choosing, building, verifying, and explaining the next issue.”
Passive observation — Never in request path
Depicted as planned per evidence rules
• Available for Tiny Robot Lab mail
ensures empirical truth in all reporting.
